in_marathi.name: Parthasarathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Servant of Artha (Righteousness)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parthasarathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who serves and protects Artha, the righteous path of dharma, and serves as a charioteer to Lord Krishna.

in_bengali.name: Parthasarathi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Servant of Artha (Righteousness)
in_bengali.long_meaning: Parthasarathi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who serves and protects Artha, the righteous path of dharma, and serves as a charioteer to Lord Krishna.

vedic_reference.note: Parthasarathi is the name of Arjuna in his role as the charioteer of Lord Krishna. He is also known as Sikhandi, Abhimanyu, and Bhishma's grandson.
